author: Souldedguy
quote: 0 / 10 — Grand Theft Auto VI is the textbook example of how to ruin a legendary franchise; it threw away the sharp writing, gritty atmosphere, and unforgettable characters, replacing them with bloated, repetitive missions and lifeless, clunky mechanics that make it an absolute skip for any true fan of the series.

author: Souldedguy
quote: 10 / 10 — The Ocarina of Time remake is the gold standard for how to revive a classic; it preserved the touching story, brilliant puzzles, and unforgettable music, while adding smooth, comfortable controls that make it a must-play for any adventure game fan.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
